landing.intro: Flavoriz is where home cooks learn by doing. Every recipe is broken into clear steps, with the time, the difficulty and the exact ingredients up front, so you always know what you're getting into before you turn on the stove.
landing.f1Text: Ingredients you can tick off and numbered steps you can follow without guessing.
landing.f2Text: Save what you love in one tap and come back to it any time.
landing.f3Text: Add your own recipes with photos and let others rate them.
landing.learnText: From a first sauce to a weeknight stir-fry, each dish teaches one technique you'll use forever.
landing.s1Text: Browse by category and check the time and difficulty at a glance.
landing.s2Text: Tick off ingredients as you go and follow every step in order.
landing.s3Text: Keep your favorites close and publish your own creations.
landing.howTitle: From craving to plate in three steps
